newsitem.title: USA: Dart Group says court denies Haft motion.
newsitem.headline: Dart Group says court denies Haft motion.

text.p: Dart Group Corp said on Monday that a Delaware court denied a request for summary judgment by Herbert Haft in his lawsuit to regain control of the company.
Dart shares were up 2 points to 92-1/4 in early trading.

Dart said the decision by the Delaware Court of Chancery denied Herbert Haft's motion for a ruling that he remains entitled to vote 172,703 Dart Class B common shares by a proxy granted by Ronald Haft in July 1994. Voting those shares would restore him to control of the company, Dart said.
Dart later repurchased those shares from Ronald Haft in a settlement with him. Herbert Haft's lawsuit challenges the legal consequences of that settlement, Dart said.
The suit has not been set for trial. Dart said it hopes the court ruling may help it reach a negotiated settlement with Herbert Haft.

The company said it has been having discussions with other Haft family members regarding their separate suit against the company, which also seeks voting control. That suit has not been scheduled for trial, either.
Dart is a retail holding company that owns Shoppers Food Warehouse.
